relations.quote: Your Venus moves, Master Shakespeare. The Lucrece is… respected.

story.body: You read at three stalls and bought nothing. Harrison asked for a third poem and you told him you had been busy with a comedy. The wedding at Greenwich stayed news. You did not take a copy of Lucrece away with you.

relations.note: he reports the poems as if they were another man's
relations.quote: Your Venus moves, Master Shakespeare. The Lucrece is… respected.

title: Heard how the two poems go

story.body: The picture is the two poems where they were. You did not take one.

title: Left both books on the board

participation.context: Wrote the morning as it was and left the night alone.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You wrote the morning down and did not turn the wedding into work. You did not answer the letter.
